description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Array', which manages a sequential array of marker objects for use in chart plotting within the PEAR Image_Graph package. It includes methods for adding markers and drawing the next marker in sequence.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Array
classes.description: A class that manages a sequential array of marker objects for chart data points, allowing addition and sequential drawing of markers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a marker object to the internal marker array, optionally calling the parent add method if the marker is of type 'Image_Graph_Element'.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the next marker in the sequence at specified (x, y) coordinates, cycling through the marker array.
